say:1:1110628001:1.text: Honored friends of Mikola! The preliminary rounds of the Warsong Festival have concluded!
say:1:1110628001:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们！战歌节初赛的赛程，到此结束！

say:2:1110628002:1.text: Advancing ahead will be the Uru Clan and the Grimmaw Clan! That includes the likes of Orson and Brutus!
say:2:1110628002:1.source_cn: 晋级两个氏族分别是乌尔氏族和黑嚎氏族！包括战神布鲁特斯...

say:3:1110628003:1.text: Who among them will bathe in supreme glory atop the Mars Peak? We'll see you at the summit!
say:3:1110628003:1.source_cn: 究竟是谁能沐浴残阳神至高的荣耀？让我们战神峰顶见！
